name: [[576,148,18]] pair-partition CPM-PP at even lift P=72 (arXiv:2610.06749 App. F.1)

provenance.construction: Pair-partition CPM-PP CSS (Okada-Kasai family, arXiv:2607.14091) at (J,L,P)=(3,8,72): H[i*P+r, j*P+(r-E[i][j]) mod P] = 1 on both sides from the 3x8 circulant exponent arrays E_X, E_Z printed in Maskara et al. arXiv:2610.06749 Appendix F.1 eq. (62). E_X=[[50,69,70,40,5,39,5,0],[32,62,69,51,61,18,6,25],[33,37,30,47,46,63,23,23]], E_Z=[[32,22,29,49,59,48,36,25],[40,67,60,70,69,37,69,30],[53,17,18,29,66,45,11,3]] mod 72. CSS commutation H_X H_Z^T = 0 reproduced from the printed arrays; k recomputed from the binary ranks (rank H_X = rank H_Z = 214, n = 576) and matched the paper's 148; row weight 8 and column weight 3 on both sides. P = 72 is even, a lift size the family's odd-P construction theory does not cover and that no board entry uses; it reaches the family's d=18 eight qubits shorter than the published odd neighbour [[584,150,18]] at P=73.
provenance.notes: Known parameters: the [[576,148,18]] triple and the explicit 3x8 circulant exponent arrays are printed in Maskara et al., arXiv:2610.06749, Appendix F.1 eq. (62), as the base code PP576 of a parallel-surgery gadget; that paper reports no new parameters of its own and contributes logical gates rather than codes. This entry is an independent reconstruction and re-measurement from those printed arrays, not a new construction, and origin stays 'submission' because the matrices were rebuilt here rather than copied from a data file. The pair-partition construction the arrays instantiate is Okada-Kasai, arXiv:2607.14091. The claimed distance is a witness-backed upper bound from this repository's own search; no lower-bound certificate for this instance is held here and the paper's exact-distance argument is not reproduced. Two things are genuinely new to the board. First, the lift P=72 is even: every (3,8) pair-partition entry on the board uses an odd prime lift (P = 29,31,37,59,61,71,73,79,83,89,97,101,103,113), because that family's construction theory needs x^P-1 square-free, so the even-lift strip was unsearched. This entry sits between the odd P=71 and P=73 points at 8 qubits shorter than the published [[584,150,18]] at P=73 and 2 logical qubits above [[568,146,18]] at P=71. Second, it dominates no existing board entry and is dominated by none: it joins the weight-8 x unrestricted Pareto frontier as an incomparable point rather than displacing anything. Equivalence checklist: the exact-fingerprint match reported when this entry was built is against this very file, not against a board entry; against the committed board the gate reports exact_duplicate_of: null and wl_equivalent_of: null. No circuit tier: the Z memory at 18 rounds has 442131 error mechanisms, over the 25000 cap, so the entry is submitted code-tier-only and the generator printed that reason.
